text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGING: elevated 5xx + timeouts observed for infer-runtime (us-west-2) across multiple model-runners. Alert group: runtime-5xx-spike. Paging eng-oncall now. logs: key errors show SIGSEGV + OOM before 5xx surge.

eng-oncall: Acked. Pulling traces and recent deploys. Can someone check node pressure and recent canary?

maria: Notified support leads, prepping holding message for customers (likely increased latency/502s). Any ETA on mitigation?

prateek: Quick snapshot: k8s events show repeated OOMKills for pod model-runner-***-canary around 02:12:10. Then a thundering cold-start pattern: dozens of replicas spinning up and hitting host memory limits.

sasha: Logs (snippet):
```
[02:11:58] model-runner pid=4221 sig=11 (SEGV) backtrace: libattn.so+0x12f4
[02:12:03] kubelet: OOMKilled container=model-runner
[02:12:05] gateway: upstream 502 from 10.0.4.21: model-runner timed out
[02:12:07] runtime: 5xx rate 23% -> 68% in 2m
```

eng-oncall: Root cause hypothesis: recent canary (image rinf:v2026.03.15) introduced a memory regression in attention kernel leading to occasional segfaults under specific sequence lengths; when crashed pods restart, autoscaler launches many replacements concurrently (thundering herd) which amplifies host memory pressure and triggers OOMs.

prateek: Commands I ran: `kubectl get pods -n inference --field-selector=status.phase=Running -o wide` then `kubectl describe pod model-runner-***-canary` showed repeated crashes at post-start healthcheck. Also `top` on host shows memory at 94%.

eng-oncall: Immediate mitigations:
- Pause canary rollout (deployment pause)
- Scale down HPA for model-runner to 1 temporarily to stop rapid restarts
- Patch node autoscaler to avoid launching scale-up until pressure subsides
- Route traffic to fallback smaller-quantized model variant (rinf-small) via gateway policy

sasha: Executed pause: `kubectl rollout pause deployment/model-runner -n inference` -> confirmed. Scaling HPA to 1 now.

ops-bot: Action taken: traffic-route updated -> fallback model rinf-small enabled for 18% of routes.

maria: Customer update draft: "We're investigating elevated 5xx and timeouts. We've routed traffic to a lower-capacity fallback to restore availability while we fix the issue. We'll follow up when we have more details." Approving? :thumbsup:

prateek: Also collecting core dumps from the segfaulting pod; saved to s3://redwood-cores/7854321122/ and attaching to the triage ticket. Preliminary gdb backtrace shows invalid memory access in quantized attention kernel.

eng-oncall: Triage plan:
1) Keep canary paused, keep fallback routing for 30m
2) Reproduce locally with similar sequence-length traffic (use load generator script)
3) If reproducible, hotfix kernel (revert commit or guard against null ptr) and cut patch release
4) Gradual rollout behind circuit breaker; monitor OOM/5xx metrics

sasha: Handoff to night oncall at 7854321200 UTC. Notified next-shift. Leaving routing in place.

ops-bot: Pager handoff posted to eng-oncall with tag @eng-oncall_night.

maria: Support notifying top-10 affected customers with the holding note. Will escalate if SLO breaches.

prateek: Adding note: customers on dedicated capacity who pin the affected variant may still see errors; sending opt-in instructions to support to toggle to rinf-small for affected customers where possible.

eng-oncall: Status update @ 7854321300: fallback routing stable, 5xx dropped from 68% -> 6% in last 8m. OOMKills decreased. Collecting core dump analysis; will open follow-up incident with root-cause PR link. If anything changes reactivate page.

maria: Thanks all — proceeding with customer comms and postmortem request.

incident-bot: Incident severity changed to SEV2 (mitigated) — follow-up required: postmortem assigned to prateek, sasha.
